findings.diagnosis: PAY, 'Accept card payments', places BANK, the unfamiliar bank API integration, after UI and COPY. BANK depends on an external team and has no de-risking spike, so integration problems would emerge after the earlier work and leave less time to adjust the payment plan.
findings.recommended_action: Propose moving BANK earlier or placing a small integration spike before UI and COPY to test the external dependency before committing to the full integration.
